name: Mozilla TLS — Intermediate
reference: Mozilla Server Side TLS guideline, machine-readable version 5.7 (ssl-config.mozilla.org/guidelines/5.7.json), configurations.intermediate.
summary: The general-purpose profile: TLS 1.2 and 1.3, forward-secret AEAD suites only (GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305).
notes: Corrected to Mozilla 5.7. protocols.allow [tls1_2, tls1_3] is configurations.intermediate.tls_versions. The cipher allowlist is 5.7's exact list: the three TLS 1.3 suites (configurations.intermediate.ciphersuites) plus configurations.intermediate.ciphers.iana -- all ECDHE/DHE GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305. FLAG: this corrects the previous file, whose summary said 'CBC allowed'; Mozilla 5.7 Intermediate has NO CBC suite (5.x dropped them), so the faithful encoding is an AEAD/forward-secret allowlist. certificate min_rsa_bits 2048 (rsa_key_size 2048), min_ec_bits 256 (certificate_curves prime256v1/secp384r1), disallow_sha1 (certificate_signatures sha256WithRSAEncryption + ecdsa-with-SHA256/384/512, no SHA-1). hsts_min_age 63072000 and ocsp_staple true are set by 5.7 but reported, not enforced.
